testHarnessDefects.symptom: The live TCP port allocator passed python -c source to SSH as separate unquoted remote-shell fragments.
testHarnessDefects.fix: Send one shell-quoted remote command and assert the exact SSH argv shape.
testHarnessDefects.regression: remote port allocation sends one shell-quoted command to SSH

testHarnessDefects.symptom: The live ACP canary required cwd and sentinel digest in one completed tool call even though real agents may establish them across multiple completed calls.
testHarnessDefects.fix: Decouple successful project reads from one provider transcript shape, then require the exact sentinel path and observed file bytes in one completed read operation or an exact project-confined ACP client read.
testHarnessDefects.regression: exact project-file evidence passes without requiring a provider-computed digest, while unrelated split calls remain non-green

testHarnessDefects.symptom: The installed terminal fixture treated one signal wait as its whole lifecycle, so a resize signal could terminate it before the Ctrl-C oracle.
testHarnessDefects.fix: Keep the fixture in a signal wait loop until the explicit interrupt handler terminates it.
testHarnessDefects.regression: installed terminal survives resize, observes changed columns, and then records the explicit interrupt

testHarnessDefects.symptom: The fake adapter returned an empty object for threads, which is not a valid DAP ThreadsResponse and produced an avoidable client parse error.
testHarnessDefects.fix: Return the protocol-valid empty threads list and retain the full initialize/launch/configure/threads/terminate assertion.
testHarnessDefects.regression: installed TCP DAP fixture returns threads: [] and the assembled journey has no invalid-response error

testHarnessDefects.symptom: The resize oracle required the first and last width to differ, even though legitimate intermediate resize activity can return to the original width.
testHarnessDefects.fix: Persist all observed widths and require at least two distinct values plus an explicit interrupt.
testHarnessDefects.regression: terminal receipt records observedColumns with at least two distinct widths

testHarnessDefects.symptom: Authorizing the synthetic .envrc after Zed opened the project left the remote directory environment cached without the fixture values.
testHarnessDefects.fix: Authorize the exact fixture directory before opening the installed app and verify both directory and surface environment hashes.
testHarnessDefects.regression: prepare phase performs exact direnv allow before launch and task/terminal receipts match the authorized environment

testHarnessDefects.symptom: The remote cleanup census matched its own Python/SSH ancestor command lines because they contained fixture paths and script names.
testHarnessDefects.fix: Exclude only exact ancestor (PID,start-time) identities, recheck every scanned identity around cmdline access, and continue to report matching sibling and descendant processes.
testHarnessDefects.regression: Linux procfs fixture excludes observer ancestry, reports the exact live matching sibling PID, then cleans that sibling up

testHarnessDefects.symptom: The standalone ACP canary exposed the expected digest in its prompt and could accept transcript-shaped evidence without proving that the project sentinel was read.
testHarnessDefects.fix: Keep expected sentinel bytes and digest oracle-side; accept only one completed read that binds the exact sentinel path to its observed bytes, or an exact project-confined ACP client read. Refuse every permission request.
testHarnessDefects.regression: prompt echo and unrelated split calls fail; exact sentinel path plus actual content passes; permission requests approve nothing

testHarnessDefects.symptom: The cleanup guard closed the created sentinel file descriptor before the route ran, so Linux could immediately reuse its inode after route-driven replacement and make the replacement appear owned.
testHarnessDefects.fix: Keep the original file descriptor pinned for the full route lifetime, compare its live identity with the pathname immediately before unlink, never unlink while process-group cleanup is unproven, and close both ownership descriptors on every path.
testHarnessDefects.regression: ephemeral cleanup refuses a route-replaced sentinel across 100 consecutive Linux-shaped runs and never unlinks while route cleanup is unproven

coverageClosureDefects.symptom: One Mac route and one Intrepid route were treated as representative of 14 and 18 independently selectable picker entries.
coverageClosureDefects.fix: Enumerate every selectable entry, bind the inventory to its canonical manifest, run each once, and require exact revision/input evidence before production readiness.
coverageClosureDefects.regression: shared coverage validator plus the Zed every-entry matrix

coverageClosureDefects.symptom: A direct ACP client could pass while the installed Zed picker, launch wrapper or session/new boundary failed.
coverageClosureDefects.fix: Require assembled_product evidence for direct variant cells, exercise every visible installed picker entry, and retain exact route evidence for every configured entry including alias-collapsed routes.
coverageClosureDefects.regression: shared validator rejects provider-only direct cells; Zed plan separates the exhaustive configured route matrix from exhaustive visible installed-picker UAT

negativeControl.interpretation: Expected fail-closed safety behavior, not a route-health acceptance result.
